messages:
Emma: Quick heads up — planning to roll out adaptive-batching v2.6 tonight at 23:00 PT. Primary goals: lower median token latency for short requests and reduce p99 spikes. Who's available to own smoke checks and rollback readiness? @Sofia @Raj @Liam :eyes:

Raj: I'm the deployment owner. I'll kick the canary at 23:00 and hold the window until 23:30. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10min observation between steps. If anything > 3x baseline error rate or latency regresses >20% at p95, we roll back.

Sofia: I'll be monitoring infra and SLOs. I'll have SRE on watch from 22:50—00:00 PT. Please post the smoke checklist link here and I’ll run the infra-specific items.

Liam: I'll run the app-level smoke tests and quick perf harness. I'll own the CLI smoke outputs. Running the following locally before canary: 
```bash
# smoke script (run from ci-runner)
./scripts/smoke/adaptive_batch_smoke.sh --concurrency 5 --seq-len 64
```
I’ll paste the results in thread.

Maya: Marketing: can we get a short release note blurb + 2 bullet customer-facing benefits? Need by 22:30 PT to queue the customer newsletter draft. Also want a short blurb for the docs banner.

Emma: Draft blurb for Maya: "Adaptive batching v2.6 improves short-request latency by up to 30% and reduces tail latency through smarter hot-path batching. No client changes required." Two bullets: 1) Faster median latency for short prompts. 2) More predictable p99 under bursty workloads. Use that and tweak.

Jess: Support: we need the rollback steps and a short playbook (how to triage customer reports). Can someone post the minimal commands and what to tell customers if we need to rollback? Also who on support is on call?

Raj: Rollback command (K8s):
```bash
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/adaptive-batcher adaptive-batcher=registry.redwood/adaptive-batcher:v2.5.8
# restart pods if needed
kubectl rollout restart deploy/adaptive-batcher -n inference
```
If we rollback during a canary, set canary weight back to 0 and re-route traffic. I'll coordinate and post exact timestamps.

Sofia: Monitoring checklist (short):
- watch p95/p99 token latency dashboards
- error rate by model and route (>0.5% alarm)
- CPU/GPU utilization + OOMs
- queue depth and batch sizes trending
I'll pin the runbook link and alert runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/adaptive-batching-monitoring

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: adaptive-batching v2.6 to inference cluster at 2026-03-17 23:00 PT (UTC 2026-03-18 06:00). Owner: Raj. Canary policy: incremental weights 5/25/50/100.

Liam: First smoke run (22:40 PT): all checks passed locally, median latency dropped ~28% for sample set A. Uploading perf snapshot to: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/1858001234/smokeA.png

Maya: Thanks — that blurb works. Small ask: can you add a one sentence "impact on billing" line? If nothing changes say "no customer-visible pricing change". Need this ASAP.

Emma: No billing change for customers. Add: "No change to billing or pricing; improvements are pure performance optimizations."

Jess: Support playbook snippet for triage: 1) Ask customer for request ID & approximate timestamp. 2) Check route-level errors and recent deploys. 3) If suspected regression, open internal incident and escalate to Raj + Sofia, advise customer we are investigating and that a rollback is possible. I'll add this to the support doc.

Raj: Will post canary rollout times and the toggle commands in 10m. Also setting CI gate to stop further rollout on failing smoke.

Sofia: SRE on watchlist: @sofia, @liam, @devops-oncall. Slack channel for live monitoring: #deploy-watch-adaptive-batching.

Emma: Final checklist for tonight (short):
- [x] Release notes blurb (Maya)
- [x] Rollback command posted (Raj)
- [x] Smoke scripts ready (Liam)
- [x] Monitoring & SRE on watch (Sofia)
- [x] Support playbook snippet (Jess)
- [ ] Post-deploy perf snapshot in thread (Liam)

Liam: Post-deploy (23:45 PT): canary at 50% held for 10m, no errors, p95 improved ~18% vs baseline, p99 stable. Uploading post-deploy graphs: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/1858001234/post_canary.png

Raj: Reached 100% at 23:55 PT. No rollback needed. Thanks all. I'll file the release ticket and close the window. :tada:

Emma: Amazing — thanks everyone. I'll send the cross-team note to #marketing and #customers with the blurb and the perf snapshots.

Jess: Marking support playbook updated and adding canned replies. Closing my watch after monitoring 00:15 PT.

Sofia: Removing SRE watch at 00:10 PT. No infra issues. Good ship. :shipit:
